distribution.summary: Sichuan; Fujian; Yunnan; Taiwan; Hong Kong; Guizhou
distribution.narrative: Huang & Lu (2015) supports mainland occurrence in Sichuan, Fujian and Yunnan. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds the first Taiwan record, with material from Pingtung University and Taichung (National Chunghsing University). Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Guizhou as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Huang & Lu (2015) provides the explicit host list retained in the current synthesis. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous on angiosperm trees and shrubs but does not enumerate additional host taxa in this Source Record; that broad statement is retained as ecological context only.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus crudiae (Panzer, 1791).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus crudiae (Panzer, 1791), VSN_3202, Scolytinae: Trypophloeini. 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) both preserve authorship (Panzer) at source level. A previous profile record gave authorship Petrov, 2016 was inconsistent with the canonical integrated taxonomic backbone identity and is not used for the current accepted authorship.
